parsed.rationale: The incident alert shows payment-svc db_query_p95_ms > 200ms for 30s. Evidence shows a commit (be29432) that drops the idx_payments_customer_created index in payment-svc version 2.4.2, which was deployed at the time of the incident. The metrics show increased db_query_p95_ms and db_pool_wait_p95_ms, and checkout-svc logs show payment call timeouts. The deployment of payment-svc 2.4.2 (d-774) matches the incident window. The checkout-svc timeout logs are consistent with payment service being slow, not the checkout service itself. No contradicting evidence exists for hypothesis-1.
